LOCAL LEGAL SERVICES

Sydney, Cape Breton & Victoria County

Legal services from Kostyantyn Mykhalchenko for clients in this region. Appointments in English, Ukrainian and Russian.

The local picture

Sydney’s main courthouse serves Cape Breton and Victoria Counties; the official directory also identifies an Eskasoni satellite location. The appropriate court and attendance arrangements depend on the case, so follow the notice and confirm the details.

Prepare for the conversation

A client in Sydney or northern Cape Breton can contact the Halifax-based practice about the six listed practice areas. Explain whether original documents, a signing appointment or a court appearance is involved so the practical arrangements can be discussed early.

Arrange your appointment

The practice is based in Halifax and welcomes enquiries from throughout Nova Scotia. Include your community, the practice area and any deadlines. Availability and the scope of representation are confirmed after an initial conversation and conflict check.
